summary: A generative groovebox firmware that starts playing a new song at every boot and keeps mutating its patterns and sounds, while you change parts or play along. A fork of HYP-1 and AMB-1.
features: Four-voice sampled synth plus eleven drums; fifth key steals the oldest
Sampled FM piano, vibes, kalimba, harp, upright bass, sax and more
One-button vibe, scale, mutate, new song and break controls
Knob effects: ring, wah, phaser, filters; changes land on the next bar
GLO page: play the keys, arpeggiator, loop the last 16 bars
Step view per track to edit, mutate or re-voice each part
